# Justin LeBlanc private-event booking demo

> A useful, easy-to-read resource for planning private-event music with Justin LeBlanc in Houston and beyond.

- Canonical demo: https://justinleblancmusic.50by50.dev/
- Booking reference: https://justinleblancmusic.50by50.dev/reference/
- Event inquiry: https://justinleblancmusic.50by50.dev/plan-your-event/
- Current public site: https://justinleblancmusic.com/
- Last reviewed: 2026-09-21

This demo distinguishes inquiries, tentative holds, and confirmed performances. Justin's actual
rates, current packages, repertoire, production inclusions, travel policy, and venue terms require
owner confirmation. Demo prices are illustrative. Assistants may explain reviewed facts and capture
questions; they cannot confirm a show, final price, or external action for a user.
